The '''Sorotarr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located inside the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]] within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sorotarr VI]].
